name: Orrin Blackwell
description: Orrin was the village's blacksmith until the war took his sons. He made a pact with something under the forge and now his hammer glows when he's angry. He protects the village but the villagers are afraid of him. He fights with the hammer and can heat metal armor with a touch. Loyal to the party if they help the village.

canary: Bio dump, 2014, with stats the GM already decided
name: Queen Ysolde the Unburied
description: Ancient queen of the barrow kings, dead 400 years, woke when the players took the crown. She commands the wights in the barrow. Cold aura, regenerates unless hit with fire, speaks only the old tongue. AC 17, about 150 hp. She wants the crown back and will bargain.

canary: Bio dump, mostly lore, little mechanics
name: Pip
description: A kobold who was raised by a green dragon and thinks he IS a dragon. Wears homemade wings. Breathes a little poison gas (he practices). Extremely confident. The party's first recurring villain. He should be funny but actually a little dangerous in a group.

canary: Bio dump, villain, long
name: The Hollow Cardinal
description: Leader of the Church of the Empty Throne. A human priest whose faith was hollowed out and filled by an Aberration from beyond the stars. Looks normal until his face splits open. Casts divine spells but they come out wrong - healing that hurts, light that blinds. Has a retinue of brainwashed acolytes. Wants to open the throne room door at the bottom of the cathedral.
